principle_violations.reason: The 'Order' class manages both order details and payment processing, mixing responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the payment processing into its own class or module, and let the 'Order' class focus solely on managing and representing orders.

principle_violations.reason: Any addition of new payment types would require modification of the 'pay' method, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a strategy pattern where different payment types are implemented as separate classes conforming to a common interface.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
